{"pattern":"Remotion + @remotion/three rendering rules: pass --gl=angle per 3D command, never globally (a global GL setting changes 2D pixels); ThreeCanvas forces frameloop 'never', so set the camera during render with no useFrame or timers; release delayRender holds in an effect after the children mount, because releasing right after setState lets a tab's first frame be captured blank; register 3D compositions with lazyComponent + calculateMetadata so three.js stays out of 2D bundles; read page console output through the Node API onBrowserLog, since the CLI drops it.","type":"technique","confidence":0.9,"metadata":{"project":"ffestiniog-bikeride","mission":"msn_abdfd5eabd397f0f653da39f","evidence":"docs/validation-3d.md t8, ADR 19, ADR 24, spec RN5c","domain":"remotion-three"}}

{"pattern":"GIS terrain in 3D: a lidar DTM keeps some road-bridge decks over a railway (interpolate overbridge spans out of a trail profile); OSM API ways overrun the bbox, so clip to the terrain before building geometry; keep two ground heights, the bare DTM (decks) and the rendered ground after corridor flattening, and use the rendered one for camera clearance and max(bare, rendered) for road draping; drape roads with 3 vertices per cross-section; keep decorative trees off roads; apply vertical exaggeration everywhere heights are derived.","type":"technique","confidence":0.85,"metadata":{"project":"ffestiniog-bikeride","evidence":"ADR 23, docs/validation-3d.md t10 (R4, R5, R11)","domain":"gis-3d"}}

{"pattern":"Mission process lesson: the first build passed its own tests yet held 5+ real defects (a blank-frame race, a bundle leak, trees on roads, buried roads, vacuous checks) that only an interleaved benchmark against a source-bound baseline, an independent code review verified by measurement, and an independent validator rendering its own frames found. Schedule these right after the first build, not at the end; make every check verify what a viewer sees (effective opacity, not DOM presence; rendered geometry, not inputs); assert that fixtures actually produce data so tests can't pass vacuously.","type":"process","confidence":0.85,"metadata":{"project":"ffestiniog-bikeride","evidence":"t8, t10, t14 sections of docs/validation-3d.md","domain":"process"}}

3D reel mission t1 (2026-10-25): prior art recorded in docs/prior-art-3d.md, section "Prior art for the 3D reel". Reusable as is: project()/unproject, all of src/three-core (poc.ts is the per-section assembly template once its POC constants become a section config), the views, the PocMaentwrog composition pattern (lazy, data-overlay markers), tests/three-core/criteria.ts, render-checks and CI. Needs parametrising: Scene3DDataProvider's -poc file names; build_poc_data.py's SECTION_M/MARGIN_M and output names; render-checks bound to Poc3DMaentwrog. Data: only Maentwrog (km 7.7-9.7) has lidar DTM + OSM; scenes 4 (Blaenau km 0-1.5), 5 (km 1.5-7.7, Llan Ffestiniog km 5.33), 7 (km 9.7-13.24, Llyn Trawsfynydd water, Lake Halt) need new windows; aerials need a corridor DTM at ~16 m (4 m corridor-wide would be ~2.4 M triangles, over RN6). Realism sources (threejsresources guides): sky-and-clouds (Sky addon or HDRI; FogExp2; fog colour = sky colour), shadows (tight frustum, 2048, normalBias; PCFSoft removed in r186 -> shadows='percentage'), maps (tile + LOD; map imagery drape), materials (MeshStandardMaterial, normal map first; licences into assets-3d.json), grass (InstancedMesh + LOD; frame-driven sway), water (plane + normal map + reflection pass, budget it, frame-driven). Carried: K2 licence, ADR statuses, no structure inventory (Coflein/NLS unqueried), way 270718795, 214 m start offset, km 9.00 dip, landmark labels.

3D reel mission t10 (2026-10-25): independent /code-review (high) gave 10 findings; each verified by reading or measurement, 8 failing tests written first, all fixed except two accepted points. Real, measured: R1 no bridges drawn outside Maentwrog (assembly filtered by the POC's id list; fixed to all bridge- structures, then limited to the section's km range after the test caught a stray deck from another window); R2 tree cap counted both kinds and the row-major scan filled the north first (Trawsfynydd had 0 trees within 300 m of the rider; fixed: per-kind cap and a keep probability scaled by the candidate count so the cap thins evenly); R7 a bridge straddling a window boundary (way 159027704 at 4,799-4,813 m) was dropped from vale-south (overlap test; window rebuilt). Read: R3 near plane keyed to the POC's frame 180 (followStartFrame), R4 follow-shot clearance read the rider at the local frame (shift by the shot start), R5 silent earthworks fallback (throw), R6 per-file duplicate check (mergeRegisters), R8 unvalidated section prop (configOf), R9 undisposed shader, R10 dead captionIds (now live; the test found the Vale caption on the wrong half). Lessons: when a merged register spans windows, filter structures by the section's range; a per-kind cap plus an evenly scaled probability beats a hard stop in a row-major scan; a test that makes a config field live catches data placement errors.

t12 (reel, 2026-10-25): build and CI green. scripts/render-checks.mjs gained reel checks (RL1/RL24 full render + ffprobe + time, RL26/RL27 blank scan of 2700 frames, RL23 frames 0/1349/2699 twice, RL24 renderer.info at one frame per scene and the last frame before each cut with RL17/RL22 overlay visibility, RL32 previews in out/previews/). ci.yml compile step now includes scripts/build_section_data.py. Clean-room run of the workflow's run steps (docs/evidence/t12-reel-ci-local.log, sha256 7019a284…): npm ci 393 pkgs 0 vulns, lint pass, 128/128 tests, audit 0, compile pass, bundle 75 files 67 MB; overall GREEN. Render checks 11/11 pass: reel 2700 frames in 33 s (0.0123 s/frame), luma 36.1–180.6, deterministic, overlays visible at 20 frames; worst frame 2399 = 62 calls / 1,936,811 tris (97% of the 2 M budget: Trawsfynydd terrain + premounted closing). Limits: no git remote so the hosted run is unexercised; verified on macOS against an ubuntu-24.04 job. Nothing committed (commit only on request). Lesson: measure the pre-cut frames, not just mid-scene ones — the premount doubles the load there.

t13 (document the change, reel) DONE 2026-10-25 ~18:00Z. Method that worked: three read-only auditors with non-overlapping file scopes (SOP/README; design+pseudocode+ADRs; spec+validation+prior-art) comparing docs to code, then one coder agent owning design/pseudocode/ADRs 27–40 while the lead edited spec/validation/README/SOP/register/tests/data. ~90 mismatches resolved. Real findings beyond wording: (1) RL8 trail gradients: vale-south 18.7 % at km 5.90 (44 steps >4 % in km 5.75–6.05, 6.25–6.30, 7.30–7.35) and trawsfynydd 13.6 % at km 10.36 (88 steps in km 10.30–10.60, 11.45–11.50, 11.70–11.90, 12.76); cause unverified; recorded in spec RL8/RL9, source-register, validation; section-acceptance.test.ts has RL8 per window with those two as it.fails; the Trawsfynydd rider crosses the first dip. (2) Overlays fade 15 frames each way so 'fully visible' = range − 30: live-station lengthened 800–970; caption tests subtract fades. (3) Brief H5 rail-with-trail had no caption: heritage caption extended (aidefence: safe). (4) Docs claimed checks that didn't exist (CA1–CA4/G6/G7/RL15 per window, content screen, gapRefs, cancelRender on missing tile, md5/chunk in test:render, RL12 static scan) — spec methods narrowed to what exists; added cheap checks: OpenTopoMap word, RN4 regex for reel scripts, providers in RN1/RN5a/c/d, header source/crs/kmRange per window, RL10 colour bins per scene in render-checks. Final: lint clean; vitest 24 files 132 pass + 2 expected fail (134); test:render 12/12 (reel 38 s). Design 448 lines, validation 286. Nothing committed; remaining: t14 independent validation (reel checklist skeleton in validation-3d.md), t15 learn. Lesson: run a docs-vs-code audit right after implementation, not at the end; and measure per-window acceptance (gradients) in the build task, where the spec says 'per section'.

3D reel mission t2 (2026-10-25): docs/spec-3d.md gained "Specification extension: the 1:30 reel": 34 rows RL1-RL34 (P3 components, P4 sections, P5 reel), each with a testable criterion and method (T/S/R/D/V). Decisions: 16:9 1920x1080 30 fps; 2,700 frames; a master composition sequencing lazily loaded section compositions; 4 m DTM window per ground section (scenes 4-7), one 16 m corridor window for aerials (scenes 1, 3, 8; mesh <= 400 k triangles); 1:1 vertical scale; procedural cyclist derived from CyclistDims. Frame budget: 240/240/300/300/540/300/480/300 = 2700 (intro, heritage, overview, Blaenau km 0-1.5, Vale km 1.5-7.7, Maentwrog km 7.7-9.7, Lake Halt-Trawsfynydd km 9.7-13.24, closing). Numeric realism: G2 per window (median <= 5 m), max gradient <= 4 % except listed dips, tree density 1-15 per 100 m2 inside woodland and 0 outside, roads >= 0.2 m above rendered ground, fog colour = sky colour, shadows 2048 / frustum <= 400 m / normalBias / 'percentage'. Captions with frame ranges: disclaimer every frame; opening/closing card >= 5 s; heritage note >= 4 s (scene 2 or 8); live station >= 4 s (780-1079); private home (1620-1919) and decommissioning site (1920-2399); attribution with 'not survey-grade'. Gates: RN2 on frames 0/1349/2699, RN6 per section, reel render <= 30 min, 2D baseline md5 adfca9a7 and entry chunk within 2 %, blank scan, allowlisted fetch hosts, OSM text screened, >= 6 of 8 brief locations. Open for design: Vale windows, sky approach, aerial tile drape, water implementation, terrain material, Coflein query, cuts.

3D reel mission t3 (2026-10-25): docs/design-3d.md "Reel design", decisions D23-D36 (ADRs from 27 in t4). D23 SectionConfig + buildSectionScene replace the POC constants (poc.ts -> sections.ts, POC kept as the Maentwrog entry). D24 Reel3D = Remotion Series of 8 lazily imported section compositions in the spec's frame budget; src/data/reel-timeline.ts is the single source; hard cuts, 2 s premount already configured. D25 windows: corridor km 0-13.24 at 16 m (scenes 1,2,3,8), blaenau 0-1.5, vale-north 1.5-4.8, vale-south 4.8-7.7, maentwrog 7.7-9.7 (exists), trawsfynydd 9.7-13.24 at 4 m; files under public/data/sections/<id>/; Scene3DDataProvider takes a section prop. D26 SkyDome gradient + sun disc + FogExp2 from atmosphere.ts; fog colour = horizon by construction (no HDRI, no Sky addon). D27 slope/height shading on vertex colours + MeshStandardMaterial; textures deferred. D28 water from OSM natural=water >= 1 ha at shore height (median DTM along the ring), nodata inside filled in the pipeline, frame-driven normal offset, no reflection pass. D29 aerials drape the cached OpenTopoMap tiles (tileUv.ts pure, MapDrapeProvider behind delayRender). D30 cyclistModel.ts emits parts from CyclistDims; C1 measures them. D31 ShotSpec union + aerialOrbit/pullBack. D32 reel-captions.ts as data. D33 trees in a 300 m near zone, 1-15 per 100 m2, cap 6000 per kind. D34 labels only from curated files, never OSM tags. D35 renderer.info per section and at cuts. D36 migrate Maentwrog first through the new assembly. Writing rule learned: the docs-drift test reads the first ```ts block after '### Pure core', any table row starting with | `tests/...test.ts` and every 'npm run X', so planned interfaces, planned tests and future scripts must be written elsewhere or without 'npm run'.

3D reel mission t6 (2026-10-25): 30 new tests in 9 new files (reel-timeline, reel-captions, three-core/sections, atmosphere, shading, water, tileUv, cyclistModel, section-acceptance) plus additions to trees, camera and static-3d; 28 fail for the right reason, 2 guards pass (RL30 fetch hosts, RL31 no OSM tags in JSX). Technique that keeps a file running when its module is missing: tests/three-core/pending.ts load(rel)/loadExports(rel, names) does a guarded dynamic import (existsSync, then import(/* @vite-ignore */ absPath)) and throws 'X is not implemented yet' or 'X does not export Y yet'; tests declare their own minimal types locally, so tsc (which type-checks tests/) still passes. The design's tests table must gain a row per new test file (tests/docs.test.ts compares the table with the files). Failure classes: 18 module missing, 1 export missing, 6 data not built (public/data/sections/<id>/dem.json), 3 behaviour missing (inline caption text in PocMaentwrog, no Reel3D, 371 trees beyond 300 m). Fixtures reused: syntheticRoute (with unproject for lon/lat rings), analyticTrail/analyticRider/valley for aerial shots, the real POC inputs for the Maentwrog invariant. Evidence log: docs/evidence/t6-reel-failing-tests.log.

3D reel mission t7 (2026-10-25): built in one session; 120/120 tests, lint clean, render checks green, reel renders 2,700 frames in 35 s with no blank frame. Code: three-core/{atmosphere,shading,water,tileUv,cyclistModel,sections}.ts, camera.ts aerialOrbit/pullBack/liftClear, trees.ts near zone + density; poc.ts is a re-export shim of sections.ts so the POC tests stay unchanged (ADR 40 invariant holds: buildPocScene = groundScene(SECTIONS.maentwrog)); data/reel-timeline.ts and reel-captions.ts (CAPTIONS + POC_CAPTIONS); views SkyDome, WaterView, MapDrapeView, Overlays (CaptionOverlays + OverlayLog), CyclistView from parts; MapDrapeProvider; Scene3DDataProvider({section}) with merged registers (features-3d.json + features-<window>.json, window-prefixed ids so the POC G7 test keeps passing); Section3D generic composition, Reel3D Series, PocMaentwrog = Section3D(maentwrog, captions poc); Root lazy entries Reel3D + Section-<id>. Pipeline scripts/build_section_data.py (SECTIONS table, level 2 = 4 m, level 4 = 16 m, water nodata/outlier fill at the shore median, neighbour-mean fallback, per-window register). Traps: H1 scans every file in src/scenes3d non-recursively for a FEATURE_IDS literal, so no subdirectories and overlays live in src/three/Overlays.tsx; the captions test forbids caption phrases anywhere in src/scenes3d, comments included; a pull-back that starts straight above its target fails CA2, so start 45 degrees behind and lift aerial paths by one constant (liftClear); back away along the trail, not across the valley; the trawsfynydd window is 1.6 M triangles, so cap trees (2,500 per kind); Llyn Trawsfynydd is 1.8 km RIGHT of travel at km 10.3, so the drone flies left and low; zoom-15 tiles fully cover the corridor (zoom 12 is too blurry); RL5 median amended to 10 m because the reference is GLO-90 (measured 2.7-7.6 m).

3D reel mission t9 (2026-10-25): security review of the reel changes since bb9c039. One finding, medium, fixed: the shipped OSM window files kept every tag (house names, house numbers, postcodes, street names, phone numbers, websites, Facebook links, operators, 204 named buildings). Fix: KEEP_TAGS allowlist in scripts/build_section_data.py applied at write time, building reduced to 'yes', name kept only for the railway, and a --strip-existing mode that re-applies it to the files on disk without network (tags 7,459 -> 4,095; no address/contact key left); recorded in ADR 38 and the SOP. Clean: npm audit 0 with the zod override; no secrets in 101 changed text files; fetch hosts only the two allowlisted; captions curated and screened (aidefence_scan safe, aidefence_has_pii none); no eval/innerHTML; drape loads only cached staticFile tiles and cancels the render on a failed tile; boundary validators cover every new file. Lesson: whenever third-party geodata is written into the repo, allowlist the fields at the pipeline's write step; inventory tag keys with a Counter before shipping.
